name: flare-smart-accounts
description: Smart contracts implementing Flare Smart Accounts.
author: Flare SC team

scripts.coverage: pnpm coverage:forge && node scripts/forge-lcov-prune.js && genhtml lcov.info.pruned --branch-coverage --output-dir coverage
scripts.build:upgrade-info: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=upgrade_validation forge clean && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=upgrade_validation forge build
scripts.validate-upgrade: openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate artifacts-upgrades/build-info --contract contracts/smartAccounts/implementation/PersonalAccount.sol:PersonalAccount --referenceBuildInfoDirs deployment/build-info-v2.0.0 --reference build-info-v2.0.0:PersonalAccount --requireReference && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate artifacts-upgrades/build-info --contract contracts/composer/implementation/FAssetRedeemComposer.sol:FAssetRedeemComposer --referenceBuildInfoDirs deployment/build-info-v2.0.0 --reference build-info-v2.0.0:FAssetRedeemComposer --requireReference && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate artifacts-upgrades/build-info --contract contracts/composer/implementation/FAssetRedeemerAccount.sol:FAssetRedeemerAccount --referenceBuildInfoDirs deployment/build-info-v2.0.0 --reference build-info-v2.0.0:FAssetRedeemerAccount --requireReference && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate artifacts-upgrades/build-info --contract contracts/smartAccounts/implementation/PersonalAccountRemote.sol:PersonalAccountRemote && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate artifacts-upgrades/build-info --contract contracts/smartAccounts/implementation/LoanSubaccount.sol:LoanSubaccount && openzeppelin-upgrades-core validate artifacts-upgrades/build-info --contract contracts/smartAccounts/implementation/MorphoLoanSubaccountRemote.sol:MorphoLoanSubaccountRemote
scripts.lint-sol: pnpm lint-sol-contracts && pnpm lint-sol-test && pnpm lint-sol-deployment
scripts.spellcheck: cspell --config .vscode/cspell.json --no-progress "contracts/**/*.sol" "test/**/*.sol" "test/tooling/**/*.ts" "deployment/**/*.{sol,ts,md}" "docs/**/*.md" README.md AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.test:tooling: tsx --test "test/tooling/*.test.ts" && bash test/tooling/execute-diamond-cut.test.sh && bash test/tooling/configure-remote-controller.test.sh && bash test/tooling/transfer-ownership.test.sh && bash test/tooling/deploy-remote-account-implementations.test.sh && bash test/tooling/deploy-sepolia-market.test.sh
scripts.slither: pip3 install slither-analyzer 2> /dev/null; rm -f ./slither.json ./slither_badge.json; slither . --filter-paths "dependencies|node_modules|mock" --json=./slither.json 2> /dev/null || true; node scripts/slither-parse.js ./slither.json
